title: TETHER: Training-Free, Elastic, ToC-Anchored Hierarchy Extraction and Recovery in Design-Driven Long Documents
abstract: arXiv:2611.24960v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Converting complex documents into structured knowledge constitutes the critical infrastructure urgently required for deploying Large Language Models (LLMs) in downstream research. However, blind to the Table of Contents (ToC) as a macro-structure, existing bottom-up paradigms rely on localized visual cues, inducing heuristic fragility in high-entropy layouts where visual prominence decouples from logical depth; meanwhile, direct LLM extraction lacks spatial grounding, triggering hallucinations in long contexts. To address this, we introduce TETHER, a training-free framework that elevates the ToC from discarded noise to a vital structural prior, enabling robust adaptation across design-driven long documents. translated_title: TETHER：面向设计驱动长文档的免训练、弹性、目录锚定的层次结构提取与恢复
translated_abstract: 将复杂文档转换为结构化知识是部署大语言模型（LLM）于下游研究所亟需的关键基础设施。然而，由于忽视了目录作为宏观结构的作用，现有的自底向上范式依赖于局部视觉线索，在视觉显著性与逻辑深度脱钩的高熵布局中导致启发式方法的脆弱性；与此同时，直接使用LLM进行提取缺乏空间定位，在长上下文中容易引发幻觉。为解决这些问题，我们提出了TETHER，一个免训练框架，它将目录从被丢弃的噪声提升为关键的结构先验，从而能够稳健地适应各类设计驱动的长文档。TETHER通过两阶段神经符号机制运行：首先，它利用受空间-语义约束增强的大型多模态模型（LMM）从原始目录构建文档骨架；其次，它采用基于锚点的对齐方法……
tldr: TETHER是一个免训练框架，通过将目录从噪声提升为结构先验，并采用两阶段神经符号机制，实现设计驱动长文档中层次结构的稳健提取与恢复。
en_tdlr: TETHER is a training-free framework that elevates the Table of Contents from discarded noise to a vital structural prior, using a two-stage neuro-symbolic mechanism to robustly extract and recover hierarchical structures in design-driven long documents.
